newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Explorers Index falls, led by gold.
newsitem.headline: Australian Explorers Index falls, led by gold.

text.p: Perth stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index fell sharply last week, with a fall of 57.5 points or 1.72 percent. The All Ordinaries Index fell 0.36 percent. Changes, in percent:
June 6 May 30 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.

"The Eyres Reed Explorer Index fell 57.5 points in lacklustre trading, falls outnumbered gains 2 to 1. A continued non-performance by bullion, weakness in some base metals and a faltering broader market resulted in many resource counters retreating for the week.

The best performers included, Bendigo Mining NL up eight cents to 23 cents after a very bullish, but somewhat preliminary, project update; Intrepid Mining Corp NL up six cents to 29 ecnts, gold and nickel hopeful Jubilee Gold

Mines NL up 2.5 cents to 23.5 cents, thinly traded Esmeralda Exploration Ltd up 7.5 cents to 44 cents and Gold Partners NL lifted 1.5 cents to eight cents after announcing a placement of five million shares at six cents.
Falls inclded Golden Cross Resources NL down eight cents to 30 cents, Giants Reef Mining NL off 2.1 cents to 7.9 cents and Electrometals Mining Ltd off two cents to 20 cents.

Socdet fell eight cents to 40.5 cents after experiencing problems with the extended well test of the Calauit 1B well in the Philippines, whilst Defiance Mining NL fell 4.5 cents to 22.5 cents despite announcing another encouraging nickel intersection at their Carr Boyd project."
